name: Pickpocket
author: byo-pop examples
description: A powerup for every mode. A Pickpocket lifts a group too small to click (a single coin, or two where three are needed), for no points. Right-click the group, or press P (or click the counter under Mr. Money) and then click it. You start with a few and get more each level. A Puzzle game goes on while a Pickpocket can still lift a coin. Keeps its own high scores.
